summary: The statement and proof are correct as written. The audit checked the smallest dimension N=1, singleton and endpoint rows, empty intermediate rows, zero-width boundary coordinates, threshold equalities, and arbitrary closed halfspaces through the constructed original integer center. The odd integer cores give the claimed halfspace mass. The coordinate estimates (5)-(7) hold with the stated constants. The Gaussian comparison (8) follows from (9)-(10) relative to the nearest sampled height on each side of a real maximizer, so missing heights cause no gap. Concavity puts every wide-coordinate superlevel interval through the midpoint, which justifies at most two blocks of each cardinality. The block comparisons, geometric sum, and conversion from n=N-1 give exactly W/(160*2^N). All conclusions use the original lattice points and original weights, and no unprovided result is needed.
